data.narrative:
Bohr Systems is a Pre-Seed stage company operating in Defense & Security, founded by Rohil Gharat (prior experience at Antler, Founders Inc., and Cisco) and Samarth Kumbla (Columbia CS '27). The Defense & Security sector contains 26 peer companies, with 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Standard peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable to Bohr Systems due to insufficient narrow-stage comparables. A search across Defense & Security for same-stage and adjacent-stage peers yielded zero same-stage datapoints, one adjacent-stage comparable, and zero similar-valuation-tier matches—all below the three-datapoint minimum required for reliable peer triangulation. Expanding to all-sector peers would introduce material distortion given stage and sector-specific dynamics in Defense & Security.

Given the absence of robust quantitative triangulation, valuation of Bohr Systems at Pre-Seed stage cannot be meaningfully anchored to public methodology. Assessment of fair value would require alternative approaches (e.g., founder pedigree discount/premium, market entry timing, technology differentiation relative to Anduril, Helsing, and other top private peers) applied outside standard comparable company frameworks. Key uncertainties center on the availability of true Pre-Seed Defense & Security benchmarks and the company's capital requirements and go-to-market timeline.
